verdict.rationale: Basecamp ships its own non-UI interfaces for automation: an official Basecamp CLI for agents and a fully documented REST API with an OpenAPI spec, OAuth, cURL examples and rate-limit retry guidance. That means its workflows can be driven programmatically without the web app. However, the CLI is described as being for agents 'you run on your computer', and nothing documents running it in CI pipelines or non-interactive auth for unattended jobs. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage, non-interactive or service-account auth for headless runs, CLI command reference depth, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: CLI access and skills for AI agents you run on your computer.
The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
Throughout the Basecamp API docs, we include "Copy as cURL" examples.
